filters.name: Sample Surface by Voronoi Relaxation
filters.shortDescription: Sample a surface and relax the samples with a geodesic Voronoi/Lloyd process.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Compute a point sampling over the current mesh and perform Lloyd relaxation on the surface. The selected vertices of the current mesh become the final seeds, and two additional layers are produced: a Voronoi region mesh and a polyline representation of the Voronoi boundaries.

parameters.label: Iteration
parameters.help: Number of Lloyd relaxation iterations.

parameters.label: Sample Num.
parameters.help: Target number of surface samples.

parameters.label: Radius Variance
parameters.help: For quality-weighted distance, the metric varies between 1/x and x according to per-vertex quality.

parameters.label: Color Strategy
parameters.help: How the current mesh should be colored during Voronoi relaxation.

parameters.label: Distance Type
parameters.help: Metric used by the Voronoi relaxation.

parameters.label: Preprocessing
parameters.help: Refine the current mesh before relaxation so the supporting triangulation is dense enough for the requested sample count.

parameters.label: Refinement Factor
parameters.help: Controls how much the mesh is refined during preprocessing. Larger values create a denser supporting triangulation.

parameters.label: Perturbation Probability
parameters.help: Probability that each seed is slightly perturbed during restricted relaxation.

parameters.label: Perturbation Amount
parameters.help: Perturbation amplitude as a fraction of the bounding-box diagonal.

parameters.label: Random seed
parameters.help: Zero draws a fresh seed on every run, so repeated applications differ; any other value makes the seed placement and relaxation exactly reproducible.

parameters.label: Relax Type
parameters.help: How a new seed is chosen inside each Voronoi region.

filters.name: Sample Volume
filters.shortDescription: Generate diagnostic Monte Carlo and surface samples inside a watertight mesh.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Compute a volumetric Monte Carlo sampling of a watertight mesh and add diagnostic sample layers. This follows the original MeshLab filter behavior: the Poisson-filtered volume point set is not emitted yet by the upstream implementation.

parameters.label: Surface Sampling Radius
parameters.help: Surface Poisson radius used as an acceleration structure for signed-distance queries.

parameters.label: Volume Sample Num.
parameters.help: Number of volumetric Monte Carlo samples to scatter inside the mesh.

parameters.label: Poisson Filtering
parameters.help: Preserve the original MeshLab option. The current upstream implementation does not emit the filtered volume layer.

parameters.label: Poisson Radius
parameters.help: Radius used by the internal Poisson pruning stage.

parameters.label: Random seed
parameters.help: Zero draws a fresh seed on every run, so repeated applications differ; any other value makes the generated sample set exactly reproducible.

filters.name: Create Voronoi Scaffolding
filters.shortDescription: Build a scaffold mesh from a volumetric Voronoi sampling of a watertight mesh.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Build a volumetric Voronoi sampling of the current mesh, relax the internal seeds, and extract a scaffold mesh from the implicit Voronoi structure.

parameters.label: Surface Sampling Radius
parameters.help: Surface Poisson radius used as an acceleration structure for signed-distance queries.

parameters.label: Volume Sample Num.
parameters.help: Number of volumetric samples used to choose and relax Voronoi seeds.

parameters.label: Volume Side Resolution
parameters.help: Number of voxels along the longest side of the implicit extraction grid.

parameters.label: Width of the entity (in voxel)
parameters.help: Width of the generated scaffold element expressed in voxel units.

parameters.label: Smooth Step
parameters.help: Number of Laplacian smoothing iterations applied to the scaffold mesh.

parameters.label: Lloyd Relax Step
parameters.help: Number of volumetric Lloyd relaxation steps for the Voronoi seeds.

parameters.label: Add original surface
parameters.help: Extract the scaffold as a structure joined to the original surface envelope.

parameters.label: Voronoi Element
parameters.help: Voronoi feature type to extract.

parameters.label: Random seed
parameters.help: Zero draws a fresh seed on every run, so repeated applications differ; any other value makes the scaffolding exactly reproducible.

filters.name: Create Solid Wireframe
filters.shortDescription: Convert the current mesh into a solid shell made of cylinders, spheres, and face prisms.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Create a new solid wireframe layer by replacing edges with cylinders, vertices with spheres or short cylinders, and faces with prisms.

parameters.label: Edge -> Cyl.
parameters.help: Replace edges with cylinders.

parameters.label: Edge Cylinder Rad.
parameters.help: Radius of each edge cylinder.

parameters.label: Vertex -> Cyl.
parameters.help: Replace vertices with short normal-aligned cylinders.

parameters.label: Vertex Cylinder Rad.
parameters.help: Radius of each vertex cylinder.

parameters.label: Vertex -> Sph.
parameters.help: Replace vertices with spheres.

parameters.label: Vertex Sphere Rad.
parameters.help: Radius of each vertex sphere.

parameters.label: Face -> Prism
parameters.help: Replace faces with extruded prisms.

parameters.label: Face Prism Height
parameters.help: Height of each face prism.

parameters.label: Face Prism Inset
parameters.help: Inset amount used to shrink each face prism toward its center.

parameters.label: Ignore faux edges
parameters.help: Preserved for MeshLab compatibility. The current VCG shell builder consumes the unique real edge set.

parameters.label: Cylinder Side
parameters.help: Number of sides used for edge and vertex cylinders.
